title: What Is Tool Calling?
description: Understand how AI agents use external tools — and what skills and plugins add to the picture.

data.text: By default, an LLM only produces text. Tool calling is the mechanism that lets an AI model reach outside its text generation to interact with the real world — searching the web, running code, reading files, and taking actions in external systems.

data.caption: Tool calling: the AI generates a structured call, the tool runs in the real world, and the result flows back to the AI as new context
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant LLM as Language Model
  participant T as Tool (e.g. Search)

  U->>LLM: "What is the current price of AAPL?"
  Note over LLM: Decides: I need
current data → use search tool
  LLM->>T: search("AAPL stock price today")
  T->>LLM: {result: "AAPL: $213.42 as of 2:03pm"}
  Note over LLM: Now has real data
  LLM->>U: "Apple (AAPL) is currently trading at $213.42."

items: You send a message to the AI
The AI decides whether a tool would help answer better
If yes: it generates a structured 'tool call' — specifying which tool and with what inputs
The tool runs independently (web search, code execution, API call)...
The tool result is inserted back into the conversation as new context
The AI reads the result and continues generating its response with that knowledge

rows: Runs code in a sandboxed environment
Analyze a spreadsheet, plot a chart
Summarize a PDF, create an Excel file
Get weather, book meeting, post to Slack
Fill in a form, navigate a webpage

data.text: Different platforms use different vocabulary for the same underlying concept. Here's a unified decoder:

rows: A specific function an agent can call — search, code run, file read
A packaged tool set that extended ChatGPT's capabilities
An HTTP API call configured as a tool the GPT can use
A named capability — maps to one or more tools under the hood
A standardized server that exposes a set of tools via the MCP protocol
The technical mechanism for defining tools in the API

data.title: What to remember
data.text: All of these terms describe the same concept: giving an AI model a way to invoke an external capability. Tool calling is the mechanism; skills/plugins/actions are the packaging. Whenever AI "searches the web" or "runs code", tool calling is what's happening.

data.title: Key ideas
points: Tool calling lets AI reach outside text generation to take real-world actions
Every AI agent is built on tool calling under the hood
The flow: model decides → calls tool → tool runs → result returned → model continues
Skills, plugins, actions, and MCP servers are all packaged collections of tools
You use tool calling every time ChatGPT searches the web or runs code for you
